hero.description: Viena Medical is a private company that has been supplying certified equipment, reagents and consumables to laboratories in Belarus since 2017. We work with manufacturers directly and never silently swap them for «analogs» — the lab gets exactly what was specified, and we share responsibility for the result.

manifesto.title: We don’t exist in order to
manifesto.p1: Laboratories rarely know what alternatives exist to their usual supplier. The supplier rarely has an interest in telling them. An entire industry has lived in that gap for decades — «closed» systems, single-bidder tenders and double-priced procurement.
manifesto.p2: We started in 2017 to do things differently. Not to win a single tender — but to slowly make the market more transparent and the budget more efficient. It is slow, sometimes uncomfortable work: we argue with customers, we argue with the regulator, we lose deals. That is the fair price for being useful.
manifesto.p3: We openly write to the Ministry of Health, the antimonopoly authority, the State Control Committee and even to the State Security Committee — and we just as openly publish that work. Not because we enjoy conflict, but because no systemic change happens without an honest public conversation.
manifesto.quote: “The lab gets exactly what was specified — and we share responsibility for the result.”

openMarket.title: An open market
openMarket.text: We systematically push for registered analog devices to be admitted to «closed» laboratory systems.

dialog.title: Professional dialogue
dialog.text: With laboratory specialists, regulators and international associations — as equals, on substance.

moh.title: 8 years of dialogue —
moh.p1: Since 2018 we have been sharing a systemic analysis of laboratory procurement with the Ministry of Health, the antimonopoly authority, the State Control Committee and the State Security Committee: where monopoly pricing forms, how «closed» systems exclude analogs, what could be done differently.
moh.p2: Some of our proposals have already made it into regulations — simplified registration of medical devices with FDA/CE clearance, exemption from on-site inspections, the first attempts to admit analogs. Some questions remain open — and we keep asking them. Not a single one of those letters is convenient for us as a company in the short term: every one of them widens the competition we ourselves participate in.

founder.name:
Maksim S.
Harbatsevich
founder.p1: Maksim founded Viena Medical in 2017. Before that — more than ten years in the field: service engineering, product lines, talking to customers from district laboratories to national reference centres. The principles the company lives by today grew out of that practice.
founder.p2: By the nature of the work he spends a lot of time inside the international laboratory community — that is the natural environment for anyone who wants to understand how laboratory diagnostics works beyond a single country.
founder.p3: These things are not the goal — they are a side effect of what Maksim is genuinely interested in: the preanalytical phase, new diagnostic formats, sane regulation. If the trade-off were fewer certificates and more time talking with heads of clinical labs, he would probably pick the second one.

publication.title: Co-author of a paper on needle morphology
publication.note: Together with Prof. Giuseppe Lippi (University of Verona) — analysis of the inner diameter of 21G blood collection needles by scanning electron microscopy. Differences of up to 35 % — a real factor in preanalytical quality.

patent.title: A wearable scanner for laboratories
patent.note: Belarus and an international application: a wrist-worn device for scanning biospecimen barcodes with HL7 FHIR support.

rome.title: Talk in Rome
rome.note: A platform for «uberising» laboratory services — at-home sample collection integrated with stationary laboratories.

process.title: Six steps from request to go-live

steps.title: Request
steps.desc: We capture the task, the laboratory team, the test menu and the budget envelope.

steps.title: Scoping

steps.title: Quote

steps.title: Delivery

steps.title: Go-live

hero.description: Viena Medical takes part in national and inter-state healthcare initiatives — from the agreement with Vietnam and the KOTRA forum in Seoul to the BMWi programme in Germany and policy proposals to the Ministry of Health of Belarus.

closed.text: Beyond the public cases we have completed more than 500 deliveries and full laboratory build-outs across Belarus and Russia. The complete portfolio is available under NDA, on request.

hero.description: Systemic letters to the Ministry of Health, the antimonopoly authority, the State Control Committee, the State Security Committee and the President of the Republic of Belarus — on demonopolising the medical-device market, switching to procurement of medical investigations, registration of devices, licensing of medical activities and Point-of-Care Testing.
